not-content.rule: the namespace of the CSF's own names `risk-party` and `example` (https://csrc.nist.gov/ns/csf)
the id of a statement part is the id of its item and `_statement`
the id of an overview part is the id of its function and `_overview`
the class of an element says on which level it stands (function, category, subcategory); the level is what makes it a function Set, a category Set or a Requirement
the name of a part selects the member its prose is written to (statement, example, overview)
the name of a prop selects the field its value is written to (label, sort-id, status)

declared-drops.reason: as decided for IFA on 2026-11-13: the uuid of a source element identifies it inside the source document only; JASCON objects get URIs minted from the ids of the source, and the uuid itself is not carried
declared-drops.reading: content: it identifies the source document, and nothing in the bundle lets a reader rebuild it

declared-drops.reason: the name of a prop selects the field its value is written to (label, sort-id, status) - of a value that is dropped: a withdrawn item that names a successor is not emitted; the bundle carries its lineage on the successor - id, label, title, statement prose and each link. Its sort-id, the place among its siblings, is none of those: a withdrawn item of this kind is a member of no Set
declared-drops.reading: not content, because the name `sort-id` only selects the value beside it; it shares the fate of that value

declared-drops.reason: a withdrawn item that names a successor is not emitted; the bundle carries its lineage on the successor - id, label, title, statement prose and each link. Its sort-id, the place among its siblings, is none of those: a withdrawn item of this kind is a member of no Set
declared-drops.reading: content: the order of the withdrawn items among their siblings. Where the siblings are members of a Set the place stays empty in their sequence; of a withdrawn item under a withdrawn category nothing in the bundle shows it

declared-drops.reason: as decided for IFA on 2026-11-13: the uuid of a source element identifies it inside the source document only; JASCON objects get URIs minted from the ids of the source, and the uuid itself is not carried
declared-drops.reading: content: the links of the document metadata, carried in the compat facet, name a resource by this uuid; without it a reader cannot tell which resource is the canonical and which an alternate one

declared-drops.reason: as decided for IFA on 2026-11-13: a back-matter resource is a link to another rendition of the source; its title and address are carried in references@1, the media type of the link is not
declared-drops.reading: content: it says what the address leads to (a PDF, a web page)
